model: Absorbing Barrier (Brownian Motion with Drift) + Asymmetric Dominance Index + Enhanced CDS

autoresearch_optimizer.description: Autonomous parameter optimization via evolutionary search (inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch)
autoresearch_optimizer.method: Evolutionary search with 40% explore / 60% exploit phases
autoresearch_optimizer.metric: Risk-adjusted ROI (Sharpe-like ratio) on walk-forward validation set
autoresearch_optimizer.overfitting_guard: Train/val split with max 2.0x overfit ratio filter

verification_framework.description: Structured go/no-go evaluation for nightly picks (inspired by everything-claude-code)
components: StrategyRubric: 6-dimension weighted scoring (accuracy, sample_size, roi, drawdown, consistency, edge_stability)
RegimeDetector: Statistical test for strategy degradation (z-score based)
AdaptiveConfidence: Rolling Kelly fraction adjustment based on recent tier performance
NightlyVerifier: Full pipeline producing DEPLOY/HOLD/SKIP recommendation

real_odds_validation.description: All profit calculations use REAL FanDuel historical odds from the Odds API

enhanced_cds_dimensions.D8_volatility_mismatch: Reliable favorites (low variance) vs volatile underdogs (0-2 pts)
enhanced_cds_dimensions.D9_b2b_penalty: Back-to-back game detection with -1.5 CDS penalty and 0.6-0.8x Kelly
enhanced_cds_dimensions.D10_pace_differential: Pace mismatch exploitation when fast team faces slow team (0-1.5 pts)

correlation_aware_parlays.description: Adjusts parlay probability estimates for inter-leg correlation

execution.honest_disclaimer: When our signal fires (team up 15+ at halftime), the ML is -800 to -2000. There is NO -110 bet available at this game state that hits 90%+. Sportsbooks adjust all lines in real-time.

PLAY_1_ML_SEQUENTIAL.when: DIAMOND signal fires during live game
PLAY_1_ML_SEQUENTIAL.bet: Moneyline on leading team at market odds

PLAY_3_PREGAME_SPREAD.when: Pre-game ADI model flags HIGH confidence game

PLAY_4_CONVERGENT_DOMINANCE.when: Pre-game CDS model flags convergent multi-dimensional dominance
dimensions: D6: Dual-Edge Bonus (0-1.5) - elite on BOTH offense AND defense
D7: Opponent Weakness Amplifier (0-1) - opponent bad at BOTH ends
D8: Volatility Mismatch (0-2) - reliable fav vs volatile dog [NEW v4]
D9: Back-to-Back Penalty (0 to -2) - B2B adjustment [NEW v4]
D10: Pace Differential (0-1.5) - pace mismatch [NEW v4]
PLAY_4_CONVERGENT_DOMINANCE.novel_value: Captures games Play 3 misses (away favorites, defense-first teams)
PLAY_4_CONVERGENT_DOMINANCE.elite_incremental: 5 games Play 3 missed at CDS>=11, 100% ML accuracy

convergent_dominance_model.name: Enhanced Convergent Dominance Score (CDS v2)
convergent_dominance_model.type: Multi-dimensional continuous scoring system with parameterized optimization

optimization.parameterized_dimensions: D1-D7 breakpoints are tunable via optimizer
optimization.validation: Real FanDuel odds from Odds API (693 games)

novel_elements.dual_edge_bonus: Extra credit when team excels on BOTH offense AND defense
novel_elements.opponent_weakness_amplifier: Detects opponents bad at BOTH offense AND defense
novel_elements.convergence_threshold: Outcomes become near-deterministic when 3+ dimensions score high
novel_elements.complementary_design: Explicitly captures games that Play 3's single-dimension filters miss
novel_elements.volatility_mismatch: NEW: Reliable favorites vs volatile underdogs (D8)
novel_elements.b2b_awareness: NEW: Back-to-back penalty reduces CDS and Kelly fraction (D9)

pathways_to_dominance.A_offense_plus_gap: Elite offense (D2) + net rating gap (D1) + home court (D5) [similar to Play 3]
pathways_to_dominance.B_defense_first: Elite defense (D3) + win consistency (D4) + home court (D5)
pathways_to_dominance.C_road_favorite: Extreme two-way dominance (D6) + massive gap (D1) [away games]
pathways_to_dominance.E_reliable_dominator: NEW: Low-variance fav (D8) + pace control (D10) + quality gap (D1)

parlay_rules.odds_formula: Product of individual leg decimal odds × correlation penalty

correlation_adjustment.note: Reduces combined probability estimate to account for correlated outcomes

adaptive_kelly.note: Kelly fraction scales based on rolling recent tier performance vs expected

b2b_filter.note: B2B road favorites excluded from parlays; B2B home gets 0.8x Kelly

nightly_verification.note: Verification framework gates deployment of nightly picks
